description: A .NET client for SpamAssassin's spamc/spamd protocol: scan, symbols, report, process, headers, Bayes learning through TELL, ping. Brings no transport of its own - you supply the streams. Async and genuinely blocking, net8.0.
rules: There is no host/port API. Implement ISpamAssassinConnection (RequestStream, ResponseStream, Dispose, DisposeAsync) and pass SpamAssassinClient an ISpamAssassinConnectionSource or a connect/connectAsync delegate pair.

spamd serves one command per connection: return a new connection from every Connect/ConnectAsync call and never cache one. The client disposes it. SpamAssassinClient itself is not IDisposable; register it as a singleton.
Methods are ScanAsync (CHECK), SymbolsAsync, ReportAsync, ReportIfSpamAsync, ProcessAsync, HeadersAsync, TellAsync, PingAsync, SkipAsync. Each blocking twin (Scan, ...) takes no CancellationToken.
A plain Stream message must be seekable; otherwise pass its length or a byte[]/ReadOnlyMemory<byte>. ProcessAsync/HeadersAsync copy the result into a destination Stream you pass and do not rewind it.

Learn and forget with TellAsync(TellInstruction.LearnAsSpam|LearnAsHam|Forget|ReportAsSpam|RevokeAsHam, message). A TELL that changed nothing is a TellResult, not an exception; spamd needs --allow-tell.
Read src/Josupeit.Mail.SpamAssassin.Client/llms-full.txt for exact signatures before writing code; do not infer members that are not listed there.
